summary: End-to-end frontend QA of LordTraining preview (Spanish). Tested register (7-role dropdown OK), login, Dashboard cards & charts, plan editor sections, all major PDF/Image exports, calculator modules, and Tactical Board. Result: ALL CRITICAL FLOWS PASS. 6/6 export downloads succeed (Plan Anterior PDF, Plan Gráfico PDF, Plan Gráfico PNG, Chart PNGs, Master Report PDF with 8 styles, Sessions Export combined PDF). Tactical Board (tactical-board.html) loads with brand logo & title 'LordTraining — Pizarra Tactica Digital'. Only persistent issue: console hydration warnings (non-blocking, pre-existing).

issues: Persistent React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td>'. Stray <span data-ve-dynamic="true"> wrappers leak into table descendants. Non-blocking; same issue reported in iterations 60/61.

action_items: (Optional/non-blocking) Clean up stray <span data-ve-dynamic="true"> wrappers inside <table>/<tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td> in DashboardPage.js datos-layout to remove persistent React hydration warnings.
(Optional) After successful registration, consider auto-login or auto-switch to login tab with email pre-filled (currently user must manually click 'Iniciar sesión' tab and re-enter credentials).
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ Role dropdown matches spec (7 roles, with localized labels). USER_ROLES is duplicated in AuthPage.js and DashboardPage.js — extract to shared constants module to avoid drift.
✓ Master Report modal is feature-rich (8 cover styles, 4 tabs, share/whatsapp/summary/quick-preview/generate). Good testability with data-testid coverage.
✓ Sessions Export modal has comprehensive controls (theme, layout, meso/micro/session selection, counter). All elements have data-testid.
✓ Tactical Board public HTML loads independently with brand logo + title — meets the 'escama de marca en la cabecera' requirement.
⚠ Persistent hydration warnings are cosmetic but pollute console; should be addressed before deployment for cleaner production logs.
